stem: Which event occurs as a result of the narrator’s conversation with Kirk?

options.label: A
options.text: Kirk decides he would enjoy having trains in his room.

options.label: B
options.text: The narrator realizes that sharing a room with Kirk is not all bad.

options.label: C
options.text: Kirk becomes excited about moving his bed into the office.

options.label: D
options.text: Dad is unhappy that the narrator tried to scare Kirk.
